426:         est_cent, est_voicing = resample_melody_series(
427:             est_time, est_cent, est_voicing, ref_time, kind
428:         )
429:     # ensure the estimated sequence is the same length as the reference
430:     len_diff = ref_cent.shape[0] - est_cent.shape[0]
431:     if len_diff >= 0:
432:         est_cent = np.append(est_cent, np.zeros(len_diff))
433:         est_voicing = np.append(est_voicing, np.zeros(len_diff))
434:     else:
435:         est_cent = est_cent[: ref_cent.shape[0]]
436:         est_voicing = est_voicing[: ref_voicing.shape[0]]
437: 
438:     return (ref_voicing, ref_cent, est_voicing, est_cent)
439: 
440: 
441: def voicing_recall(ref_voicing, est_voicing):
442:     """Compute the voicing recall given two voicing
443:     indicator sequences, one as reference (truth) and the other as the estimate
444:     (prediction).  The sequences must be of the same length.
445: 
446:     Examples
447:     --------
448:     >>> ref_time, ref_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('ref.txt')
449:     >>> est_time, est_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('est.txt')
450:     >>> (ref_v, ref_c,
451:     ...  est_v, est_c) = mir_eval.melody.to_cent_voicing(ref_time,
452:     ...                                                  ref_freq,
453:     ...                                                  est_time,
454:     ...                                                  est_freq)
455:     >>> recall = mir_eval.melody.voicing_recall(ref_v, est_v)
456: 
457:     Parameters
458:     ----------
459:     ref_voicing : np.ndarray
460:         Reference boolean voicing array
461:     est_voicing : np.ndarray
462:         Estimated boolean voicing array
463: 
464:     Returns
465:     -------
466:     vx_recall : float
467:         Voicing recall rate, the fraction of voiced frames in ref
468:         indicated as voiced in est
469:     """
470:     if ref_voicing.size == 0 or est_voicing.size == 0:
471:         return 0.0
472:     ref_indicator = (ref_voicing > 0).astype(float)
473:     if np.sum(ref_indicator) == 0:
474:         return 1
475:     return np.sum(est_voicing * ref_indicator) / np.sum(ref_indicator)
476: 
477: 
478: def voicing_false_alarm(ref_voicing, est_voicing):
479:     """Compute the voicing false alarm rates given two voicing
480:     indicator sequences, one as reference (truth) and the other as the estimate
481:     (prediction).  The sequences must be of the same length.
482: 
483:     Examples
484:     --------
485:     >>> ref_time, ref_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('ref.txt')
486:     >>> est_time, est_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('est.txt')
487:     >>> (ref_v, ref_c,
488:     ...  est_v, est_c) = mir_eval.melody.to_cent_voicing(ref_time,
489:     ...                                                  ref_freq,
490:     ...                                                  est_time,
491:     ...                                                  est_freq)
492:     >>> false_alarm = mir_eval.melody.voicing_false_alarm(ref_v, est_v)
493: 
494:     Parameters
495:     ----------
496:     ref_voicing : np.ndarray
497:         Reference boolean voicing array
498:     est_voicing : np.ndarray
499:         Estimated boolean voicing array
500: 
501:     Returns
502:     -------
503:     vx_false_alarm : float
504:         Voicing false alarm rate, the fraction of unvoiced frames in ref
505:         indicated as voiced in est
506:     """
507:     if ref_voicing.size == 0 or est_voicing.size == 0:
508:         return 0.0
509:     ref_indicator = (ref_voicing == 0).astype(float)
510:     if np.sum(ref_indicator) == 0:
511:         return 0
512:     return np.sum(est_voicing * ref_indicator) / np.sum(ref_indicator)
513: 
514: 
515: def voicing_measures(ref_voicing, est_voicing):
516:     """Compute the voicing recall and false alarm rates given two voicing
517:     indicator sequences, one as reference (truth) and the other as the estimate
518:     (prediction).  The sequences must be of the same length.
519: 
520:     Examples
521:     --------
522:     >>> ref_time, ref_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('ref.txt')
523:     >>> est_time, est_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('est.txt')
524:     >>> (ref_v, ref_c,
525:     ...  est_v, est_c) = mir_eval.melody.to_cent_voicing(ref_time,
526:     ...                                                  ref_freq,
527:     ...                                                  est_time,
528:     ...                                                  est_freq)
529:     >>> recall, false_alarm = mir_eval.melody.voicing_measures(ref_v,
530:     ...                                                        est_v)
531: 
532:     Parameters
533:     ----------
534:     ref_voicing : np.ndarray
535:         Reference boolean voicing array
536:     est_voicing : np.ndarray
537:         Estimated boolean voicing array
538: 
539:     Returns
540:     -------
541:     vx_recall : float
542:         Voicing recall rate, the fraction of voiced frames in ref
543:         indicated as voiced in est
544:     vx_false_alarm : float
545:         Voicing false alarm rate, the fraction of unvoiced frames in ref
546:         indicated as voiced in est
547:     """
548:     validate_voicing(ref_voicing, est_voicing)
549:     vx_recall = voicing_recall(ref_voicing, est_voicing)
550:     vx_false_alm = voicing_false_alarm(ref_voicing, est_voicing)
551:     return vx_recall, vx_false_alm
552: 
553: 
554: def raw_pitch_accuracy(ref_voicing, ref_cent, est_voicing, est_cent, cent_tolerance=50):
555:     """Compute the raw pitch accuracy given two pitch (frequency) sequences in
556:     cents and matching voicing indicator sequences. The first pitch and voicing
557:     arrays are treated as the reference (truth), and the second two as the
558:     estimate (prediction).  All 4 sequences must be of the same length.
559: 
560:     Examples
561:     --------
562:     >>> ref_time, ref_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('ref.txt')
563:     >>> est_time, est_freq = mir_eval.io.load_time_series('est.txt')
564:     >>> (ref_v, ref_c,
565:     ...  est_v, est_c) = mir_eval.melody.to_cent_voicing(ref_time,
566:     ...                                                  ref_freq,
567:     ...                                                  est_time,
568:     ...                                                  est_freq)
569:     >>> raw_pitch = mir_eval.melody.raw_pitch_accuracy(ref_v, ref_c,
570:     ...                                                est_v, est_c)
571: 
572:     Parameters
573:     ----------
574:     ref_voicing : np.ndarray
575:         Reference voicing array. When this array is non-binary, it is treated
576:         as a 'reference reward', as in (Bittner & Bosch, 2019)
577:     ref_cent : np.ndarray
578:         Reference pitch sequence in cents
579:     est_voicing : np.ndarray
580:         Estimated voicing array
581:     est_cent : np.ndarray
